items.name: Mercy B.
items.quote: I was terrified of driving in town traffic. My instructor was so patient — three months later I passed my test on the first try.

items.name: Joseph K.
items.quote: Booking lessons around my work shifts was so easy. The dual-control car made me feel safe from lesson one.

items.name: Grace M.
items.quote: Hadn't driven in 6 years. The refresher course got my confidence back in just two weeks.

items.name: Alinafe T.
items.quote: The theory classes actually explained why the rules exist, not just what they are. It stuck with me.

items.name: Daniel P.
items.quote: My instructor came with me to the test centre and it made all the difference to my nerves.

items.name: Ruth C.
items.quote: Learned to ride a motorcycle safely in two weeks. Worth every kwacha.
